charts.buybackLead: 100% of token and NFT launch fees (USDC/USDT) go to public PPL buybacks. 30% of network fees go to public PPL buybacks (treasury 20% + liquidity 10%). The remaining 70% go to validators (30%), the community pool (25%) and the Growth Pool (15%) — and it all ultimately goes back to participants.
charts.vestingCaption: {{pct}}% of supply. 0% at launch, a {{cliff}}-month cliff, then {{vest}} months linear — fully vested at month {{total}}.
charts.roadmapLead: Each stage starts when its gate is met. No dates are promised.

roadmapStages.title: Season 0 · Public testnet
roadmapStages.body: Wallets, verification, token launches, NFT cards, swaps, Million Founders points.

roadmapStages.title: Mainnet + PPL sale
roadmapStages.body: Mainnet launches. Published sale parameters (exponential curve from $0.005 per PPL, up to 100M PPL; the sale ends when sold out or after 24 months) are on /buy; purchases stay disabled until the sale hub contract is deployed.
roadmapStages.gate: Gate: 1,000 verified people + a live 2-of-3 treasury multisig

roadmapStages.title: Staking & validators
roadmapStages.body: Staking and validator participation open beyond the project.
